simple.meaning: מִקְוָה (miqvâh) is a Hebrew word meaning “a collection , i.e. (of water) a reservoir.” BibleIQ connects the English word back to this source word so its use can be compared across Scripture.
simple.biblicalBackground: This word has limited occurrence data, so BibleIQ begins with the Hebrew word, its basic meaning, and the verse where it appears.

simple.whyItMatters: English translations can use the same English word for different Hebrew words. BibleIQ anchors the study in מִקְוָה (H4724) before moving outward to related references.
